body:
Directly continues selfhost/lexer.prn (founder real-time: 'self hosted compiler' -> 'continue' -> 'clnt'/'continue'). New selfhost/parser.prn: a real, faithful PARENA-language port of src/parser.c (VS0's own recursive-descent reader), consuming the lexer's own tokenize output, producing the generic S-expression AST src/ast.h defines. Real design departures forced by VS0's own confirmed current limits: no setjmp/longjmp (every parse function returns a real Result ParseStep SelfhostParseError, propagating Err upward through ordinary match-based short-circuiting -- stdlib/regex/syntax.prn's own precedent); Node.children is (Vec Node) @ Region, the same already-proven shape stdlib/regex/syntax.prn's own PatternNode uses for its own recursive Concat/Alt variants; no in-place node_push_child mutation -- children accumulate into a local Vec via ordinary vec/push! before the parent Node is constructed once, fully formed, the same shape stdlib/string.prn's own split already uses. Found and fixed a real, deeper compiler gap along the way (confirmed live via a real 'dereferencing void* pointer' gcc error, that ALSO produced a wrong runtime value once merely compile-fixed with a naive cast -- caught by a real end-to-end runtime check before it shipped): the emitter's own type-hint mechanism for a single-field Ok/Some payload was, by its own header comment's honest admission, only valid for Ok/Some specifically, with no equivalent for Err/None. Added the real, symmetric counterpart (resolve_result_error_type, scrut_error_type, a new error_type field on DefnReturnType). Also fixed 2 smaller real bugs caught before they ever compiled: a naming collision between this file's own ParseError and stdlib/string.prn's pre-existing, differently-shaped ParseError (renamed to SelfhostParseError); an invalid -> inside a function name, which the mangler doesn't handle. 51 real assertions in tests/test_selfhost_parser.c, hand-traced against src/parser.c's own real, documented behavior -- including the DoD's own exact required error wording for 3 of 4 real failure cases. Full local suite + bazel build/test + real mingw cross-compile all clean, zero regressions. CI green on all 4 platform jobs. NORTHSTAR.md's own 'Self-hosting' section extended. PARENA commit 7fe70e4, release v0.86.0.

⚓ ☃
title: v0.86.0: real second step toward a self-hosted PARENA compiler -- parser.prn
